lead_profile_text: Looking to buy a property for short term letting
property_situation: Buying a barn (advertised 2-bed, would let as 3-bed); second viewing 2 Oct, minded to offer; lender already asked for management-company info
primary_blocker: Offer not yet accepted; credibility of £71.5k gross vs two lower estimates
language_signals: we've got other income to prop it up

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: second viewing tomorrow and minded to put in an offer
delay_signals.timeline_given: Call back 8 Oct once offer accepted

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit on your current situation and situation with the property, and then we can go through the figures and our service if it lines up with what you're looking for.
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: I think we can go through some of the figures and then our service
meeting_flow.income_intro: about £71,500 of revenue, about just under £6,000 per month... payout... about £3,100 or £37,000 a year
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: our next part... what do you get for that sort of service?
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: ramp-up caveat 10-15% less for up to a year
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: give me a call back this time next week

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How did you arrive at that nightly rate and the overall gross? I've had a couple of other estimates that come in much lower.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Based on 12 comparables; 3 nearby doing more; comps have momentum so expect 10-15% less for up to a year
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: And you say it's not competitive. Is that simply because there isn't the supply of stock?

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Talk me through your fees again... do you take the platform fees off first?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: 15% + VAT of gross after platform fees

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Are there any restrictions on time owners can spend at the property?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: No; block dates and tell us via Slack

lead_responses.what_lead_said: What experience did you have? How have you built that into your offering?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Own Airbnbs 6 years; frustrated with poor communication from managers; built Slack channel, vetting, review calls

conversion_gaps.gap: Credibility of the gross vs other lower estimates
conversion_gaps.evidence: a couple of other estimates that come in much lower
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Verify 3-bed assumption from listing link; send comps with reviews
Prepare lender letter / signed income projection on request

positive_shift_moments.lead_response: I can live with that worst-case

friction_moments.what_caused_friction: Monday said 'no mortgage' but a lender is involved

opening_phrases: I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit on your current situation and situation with the property, and then we can go through the figures and our service if it lines up with what you're looking for.
reassurance_phrases: If you can live with the worst case, the rest of it's obviously all sort of benefit
zac_language.numbers_framing: Gross → three costs → best/likely/worst months → rural seasonality
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Honest ramp-up caveat; story of own experience

profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For lifestyle PURCH buyers lead with flexibility and owner-stay freedom; wait for offer acceptance before any offer framing.
